details:
Currently, indiscriminate and malicious kick vote griefing by new or troll users has become a serious issue, especially within the Japanese VRChat community.Users are frequently initiating kick votes randomly against innocent players with no reason. This troll behavior is causing significant frustration, particularly for beginners and casual players, leading to a worsening community atmosphere and even causing some users to leave VRChat.Current Problems with the Kick Vote System:Malicious users can easily and repeatedly initiate kick votes with little to no restriction.

There is virtually no penalty for players who abuse or misuse the kick vote feature.

The system lacks sufficient deterrents, and the high anonymity makes abuse easy.

Proposed Solutions:Implement penalties for troll/malicious kick votes

(e.g., temporary suspension of kick vote rights after repeated invalid votes, warnings, or other restrictions)

Add countermeasures against wrongful kick votes

Allow the community to more easily vote to kick users who repeatedly initiate unfair kick votes against innocent players (or add a dedicated reporting system for vote abuse).

Increase transparency in kick votes

Make the user who initiated the vote clearly visible, and/or add a short optional reason field when starting a vote.
title: Strengthen Measures Against Kick Vote Abuse (Indiscriminate Kick Voting Griefing)
